tasks.name: 延迟总结
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
// ====== 延迟总结楼层 配置 ======
(async () => {
    // ====== 修改这里 ======
    const FLOORS = 2;  // 保留最近 N 层不纳入总结；0 = 不延迟（立即总结到最新）
    // =====================

    const mod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/story-summary.js');
    const v = mod.setSummaryDelayFloors(FLOORS);
    window.toastr?.success('✅ 延迟总结楼层已保存: ' + v + ' 层');
})();
<</taskjs>>
